source: Rules of thumb used in first-pass real-estate arithmetic: property tax around 1.1% of value a year (US average effective rate), homeowner's insurance around 0.5%, maintenance around 1% (the '1% rule'), closing costs around 3% of price to buy, selling costs around 8% (agent commissions plus closing) to sell, an 8% vacancy allowance on rent, and a 30-year fixed term.
confidenceNote: Every figure is a national rule of thumb; property tax alone ranges from under 0.3% to over 2% by state. The template shows which it used; the room lets the price and rate be changed, and the rest can be edited here.
note: Rates are decimal fractions of price per year. Guardrails: PITI over 25% of gross monthly income reads amber; a DSCR under 1.2 reads amber; cash after closing under the emergency-fund floor reads red. D-087.
